figures.caption: Cytotoxic and hemolytic effects of pseudin-2 and P2-LZ peptides in HaCaT cells (A) and mouse erythrocytes (B). (A) After 24 h incubation of HaCaT cells in the presence of pseudin-2 or P2-LZ peptides, cell proliferation was measured using Alama Blue assays. Data are expressed as the means ± standard deviation from three independent experiments (* p < 0.05, ** p < 0.01). (B) Mouse red blood cells were incubated for 4 h in the absence (a) or presence of 0.1% Triton X-100 (b), melittin (64 µM) (c), pseudin-2 (64 µM) (d), P2-LZ1 (64 µM) (e), P2-LZ2 (64 µM) (f), P2-LZ3 (64 µM) (g), P2-LZ4 (64 µM) (h), or P2-LZ5 (64 µM) (i).
